title: Townsend Brown's experiments in oil

tellings.quote:
I he
did things in oil.

plain: The American experimenter Thomas Townsend Brown, whose work comes up on the show in connection with antigravity propulsion, is said to have run some of his experiments with the equipment sunk in oil. A guest named Charles Buhler, whom the show presents as a NASA figure who has built such a propulsion system himself, mentions it to Michels in passing ("he did things in oil") without saying how he knows. Buhler raises it as part of the background to his own claim that electric fields can push an object without anything being thrown out the back.
